review.imagery: All thirteen original current-project images were visually inspected. Labels describe the visible scene, with the villa concept, shared amenities and home interiors kept distinct. The community aerial serves the owned listing card.
review.floorPlans: Root screened every page of the 12-page apartment pack, 30-page townhouse pack and earlier 74-page brochure. All selected complete apartment, townhouse and section sheets were visually inspected. Apartment area tables, townhouse BUA and differing earlier totals were checked against visible originals. Source notices remain intact. Twenty-one drawing choices preserve conflicting revisions without merging them.
review.location: All eight current-page destination times checked. Full regional brochure page 14 and master plan reviewed. The current active-project map conflicts with printed/header coordinates, so no exact interactive pin is asserted.
review.provenance: All three complete branded PDFs were retrieved through ordinary public GET on 7 November with byte lengths and SHA receipts. The hosting brokers remain explicit. No forms submitted and no access challenges bypassed.

unavailable: Verified 1 BR apartment drawings, individually approved villa-plot house plans, resolved MU09/10 versus MU11/12 labels and a confirmed visitor entrance remain unavailable. Published drawing revisions and totals conflict.
